subject.title: fix(agents): bound model catalog JSON response reads for bedrock-mantle and huggingface

question: Should this branch remain the Hugging Face landing branch after dropping Mantle, or should maintainers close it in favor of the clean focused Hugging Face PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97743?
rationale: Both paths can solve the remaining Hugging Face hardening, but current maintainer preference and branch ownership determine whether to ask this contributor to refresh or to consolidate on the already clean focused PR.

options.title: Refresh As Hugging Face Only
options.body: Ask the contributor to drop all Mantle production/test hunks, rebase on current main, and add direct Hugging Face changed-path proof before merge.

options.title: Use The Focused Hugging Face PR
options.body: Close or pause this combined branch and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97743 as the canonical Hugging Face landing path.

options.title: Maintain A Combined Branch
options.body: Only keep a combined landing path if a maintainer intentionally wants to reassemble Mantle and Hugging Face work despite Mantle already being merged separately.

recommendation.title: Refresh As Hugging Face Only
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to drop all Mantle production/test hunks, rebase on current main, and add direct Hugging Face changed-path proof before merge.
